executive_assessment.text: The communication reports that more than 80 percent of Kenya is arid or semi-arid; typical annual rainfall is 200-500 mm in arid areas and 600-1,000 mm in semi-arid areas, and is erratic.
The NDC reports that floods in 2024 affected 412,763 people, including 107,318 women of reproductive age and 9,300 pregnant women whose health services were disrupted.

The government reports that resilience investments across 23 drought-prone counties reduced the worst suffering and livelihood losses during the 2021/23 drought relative to 2016/17, despite the later drought's greater severity.
